record.title: TCPS CELL2 — R83 shared graph driver
record.body: Andon FANOUT_ZERO_ROWS + VERIFIER_FOLDED_HEREDOC observed independently in autofde-lab and autofde after exact ggen construction. Root correspondence: the pack template lacked an explicit SPARQL/for_each driver even though ggen frontmatter law merges project and pack ontologies into one shared graph. Shared defect returned upstream once as R83; three ready consumers regenerated in parallel. MUDA reduced by removing bespoke interpretation, MURA reduced by repairing all ready AutoFDE/XaaS seams in one wave, MURI reduced by retaining admission-gated ready-set and not spawning unresolved targets.
